description: Robo packs a picnic but gets the sums wrong! Duck, Bunny and Bear help him put two groups together and count them all, with sums up to 5. Then 4 and 1, and 3 and 2, both make 5.

youtube.title: Adding for Kids! 🍎 Picnic Math, Sums to 5 | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Robo packed a picnic, but his sums are a bit muddled! Help him put two groups together and count them all: apples, strawberries, cupcakes, plates and eggs, with sums up to 5. Use your fingers to add along. Then a surprise: 4 and 1, and 3 and 2, both make 5!

Try it at home with a grown-up: put 2 snacks on one side of a plate and 1 on the other, push them together and count them all. Cut grapes and round snacks small for young children, and sit down to eat.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Picnic adding! What a sunny day.
I packed two apples, and one more apple.
Oops! Can you help me count?
Two and one more makes three!
Three apples in all. Thank you, friends!
Two and one more makes three.
Now one finger. And one more finger.
One and one more makes two!
You have five fingers on one hand. Wiggle all five!
Two and one more. Push them together. Count them all: three!
Strawberries wear their seeds on the outside!
Two and two more makes... twenty-two!
Two and two more makes four!
Two and two more. Push them together. Count them all: four!
Many bears love to eat berries.
Three and two more makes six!
Three fingers. And two more fingers.
Five cupcakes! Three and two more makes five.
Three and two more. Push them together. Count them all: five!
Time to sit down. Plates, please!
One for Duck. One for Bunny. One for Bear.
Four and one more. How many plates?
Push them together. One, two, three, four, five!
Four and one more makes five plates!
Everyone has a plate. Even Robo!
Now, eggs! Two groups of eggs.
Here, four eggs, and one more egg.
There, three eggs, and two more eggs.
Push them together. Count them all!
Wow! Two ways to make five!
Four and one makes five. Three and two makes five!
One. One apple, and one more apple.
Two. Two berries, and one more berry.
Three. Three cupcakes, and one more.
Four. Three eggs, and two more eggs.
Put them together. Count them all!
A sneak peek: two plus one equals three!
